description: This file defines the FatalErrorHandler class which implements error handling logic for fatal exceptions within the Orleans Runtime. It manages how fatal errors are logged, displayed, and triggers process termination.

classes.name: FatalErrorHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for handling fatal errors in the Orleans runtime, logging detailed error information, and terminating the process if a fatal exception occurs.

methods.name: IsUnexpected
methods.description: Determines whether an exception is considered unexpected, specifically ignoring ThreadAbortException.

methods.name: OnFatalException
methods.description: Handles a fatal exception by logging it, printing detailed info, pausing briefly, breaking if a debugger is attached, and terminating the process.
